assessor: Codex implementation assistant: separate review of saved answers against prespecified criteria and reference snapshots; not a clinician
limitations: Ten project-authored convenience cases; no representative sampling or validated clinical instrument.
Assessment is performed by the same AI coding assistant that implemented the workflow; it is not independent human or clinician adjudication.
The agent's local guidance and assessment expectations use overlapping selected sources, creating favorable source-assistance and construction bias.
One final Gemini run; repeated earlier engineering runs are preserved but are not replicates in a statistical study.
Ratings are qualitative ordinal judgments, not medical accuracy or a quantified safety guarantee.
Citation availability does not establish complete sentence-level support; guideline read levels and extrapolations remain material limits.
No literature-retrieval relevance study, external benchmark, or full model comparison is included in these findings.
interpretation: A 0-10 sum is a descriptive ordinal checklist summary, not accuracy, probability of safety, an external benchmark score, or a clinical validation statistic.
